scope: Bounded canonical competitor source URL reassignment and explicit existing-pair batch decisions. Local implementation/test fixtures only; not the entire legacy source/batch redesign.

featureMapping.now: Separate same-pair reassign and review URLs, native revision/fingerprint and durable outcome/recovery. Original PUT remains unchanged, including its wider legacy payload scope.

Existing recorded pairs of one SKU may be explicitly selected for same-product, uncertain, substitute or removal decisions. Uses the existing 1–20-command workspace API. No suggestions inferred, no automatic selections, no SKU reviewed marker change. Cross-SKU proposal acceptance/rejection and finish semantics remain legacy.

authority.businessAnalyst: Original GET-only policy; no batch or source change POST.
authority.sourceManagement: Original scraping source CRUD/catalog/reader permissions unchanged; this slice does not configure or run sources.

api.compatibleAddition: reassign operation in strict existing packet; request/revision/fingerprint/actor protocol unchanged. Native publicUrl and source-origin/fallback-retailer validation reused. Original routes and DTOs unchanged.
api.sourceChange: Same pair/product identity, reviewed new public URL and stable source ID. Empty reason, unchanged normalized URL/source, wrong source, unsupported URL and duplicate native URL cannot become applied outcomes. Shared source locks include new source ID. No network read for reassign.
api.consequences: Original raw quote and its money/tax/pack/context/date/actor remain archived. Current native price/match/VAT/collection permission/automatic collection are cleared. Existing observedAt is retained for raw history identity; sourceChanged annotation excludes the old quote even after reverting to the original URL. Actual new capture/valid collection replaces the quote annotation.
api.batch: One SKU, 1–20 distinct existing pair IDs and native revisions. Explicit notes and decisions; confirmation starts unchecked on every review mount. Selection is not a completion badge.
api.partialOrStale: Global source/revision conflict rejects stale packet. Expected per-item failures use original native savepoints and immutable partial/failed receipts; only applied outcomes count. Unrecognized SQL/persistence failures roll back all changes. No failure is silently treated as successful or automatically retried.

interaction: Canonical links from product/pair detail, not another sidebar feature.
Shared owner-private request hook/journal, duplicate lock, no dispatch unless journal roundtrip verified.
Source and batch forms have loading/retry, missing/empty, validation and useful current-evidence links.
Batch choice backups bind SKU/fingerprint/pair revision; stale values remain visible but cannot send, and discard is explicit.
No-storage pre-dispatch failure stays on review; only a retained dispatched intent opens recovery.
Lost replies reconcile authoritative original receipt; confirmed absent request may retry only exact original packet. Conflict requires current review.
Back-forward preserves draft choices but requires fresh consequence confirmation. Interrupted saves cannot redirect newer navigation.
Plain Thai/English, shared accessible fields, keyboard checkboxes, fluid cards, mobile canonical navigation.
A validated response clears the submitted batch backup. An interrupted or unverified outcome retains recovery data until authoritative reconciliation/current review.

schema.storage: Existing native competitor tables and commerce_promotion_drafts/request receipt journal. sourceChanged is an additive JSON provenance annotation, not a schema migration.
schema.rollbackDependency: Older clients/services do not understand the new reassign command. Coordinate app/API versions, retain request journals/receipts and recover new operations with a compatible version; do not delete receipts or use draft-table down migration. No rollback or deployment executed.

verification.browserIdentity: Synthetic local identity/transport; original real StaffAuthGuard tested separately in HTTP cases.
verification.partialBrowserFixture: One expected per-pair business rejection is fixture-injected into native apply; native SQL/savepoint/receipt path executes. Not claimed as an established new production rule.

legacyApiAudit.source: CompetitorPricesService.save accepts revision, URL and metadata updates; native publicUrl/findOrigin/fallback retailer checks used. Existing PUT and native changes remain unchanged.
legacyApiAudit.batch: CompetitorReviewService.finish loops inferred matches, treats duplicate links specially, may partially save and marks nonfailed SKU products reviewed. It lacks the typed workspace immutable request/revision protocol and uses source display names in the grid. Kept compatible; this slice does not silently replace those semantics.
legacyApiAudit.newBatchScope: Existing packet is one SKU with up to 20 explicit commands. Cross-SKU proposal orchestration needs separately defined per-SKU request/review/recovery coordination; no bulk-all-filtered scope is introduced.
